title: Phantom and Blade - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Phantom and Blade trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Phantom and Blade phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. Tied to the dragon pillar chain - the pillars are the quest's collectible, so this and the true ending share a checklist item.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 18 of 36 on the list - before it Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake · after it Even Trees Know Sorrow. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
